description: 1 x London plane (T192): Remove 2 no. Massaria infected large branches (i) at approximately 8 m height growing to north (300mm diameter and 6m length) and (ii) 13 m growing to south (200mm diameter and 6m length). 1 x London plane (T229): Remove early stage Massaria infected stubbed limb at 11 m height growing to south east (120mm diameter and 1m length). 1 x London plane (T370): Remove Massaria infected large branch at 15 m height growing to south east, (approximately 8m in length and 300mm in diameter).1 x London plane (T381): Remove 3 no. Massaria infected large limbs (i) at 8 m height growing to south west located approximately 10 m out on lateral limb, (6m in length, 200 mm diameter),  (ii) at 7 m height growing to north west (4.5m length, 200mm in diameter), and  (iii) at 16 m height growing north west  over road (4 m length, 200mm diameter).1 x London plane (T721): Remove Massaria infected limb at 9 m height growing to south (5 m length and approximately 300 mm diameter).1 x London plane (T728): Reduce Massaria infected large limb at 7 m height growing to north east (the end of the long lateral branch alongside the pavement) by approximately 3.5 m.1 x London plane (T921): Remove Massaria infected large branch at 7 m height growing to north east (4 m in length and 450 mm diameter attached beneath main union of tree).1 x London plane (T959) : Remove Massaria infected large limb at 12m height growing south west (8 m length and 300 mm diameter).1 x London plane (T948): Remove suspended Massaria branch at 9 m  height growing to the west over a footpath, (2 m length  x 30 mm diameter).
